text:
Hello,

Moosacker Services Ltd in Kriens has given me notice. Alice Hürlimann, the HR manager, sent the letter, and I signed for it on 11 October 2026.

My written contract says three months' notice to the end of a month after the trial period, which is a month longer than what the law would give someone who has been there as long as me. The letter does at least go by that, and says my job ends on 31 January 2027.

What happened next is why I'm writing. The notice came first, and only four days later, on 15 October, I fell off a ladder while cleaning the gutters at home and broke my wrist and two ribs. So the accident happened while the notice period was already running, not before.

About the trial period, since Ms Hürlimann brought it up on the phone: in my case the contract set it at three months in writing, not the usual one month.

Since the accident I've been completely unable to work. My doctor has signed me off until at least the end of November and I send in every certificate. My colleague Mark Gisler has taken over my rounds.

I've been with the company since March 2023, so the trial period was over long ago when the notice came. It has nothing to do with that.

I'm attaching the notice period clause, the notice letter and the first page of my contract.

I earn CHF 1,010 a month, part-time. Does my accident change the date my job ends? And do I still get paid while I'm off sick?

Kind regards,
Paul Turner
Mattenweg 119, Kriens

Mr Paul Turner
Mattenweg 119
6010 Kriens

Kriens, 9 October 2026

Termination of your employment

Dear Mr Turner

We hereby give notice to terminate your employment, observing the agreed notice period. Your employment will end on 31 January 2027.

Until then we ask you to continue your work as usual. Your reference and final salary statement will be sent to you at the end of your employment.

---
Registered mail. Received by the addressee on 11 October 2026: P. Turner

EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT - page 1

1. Start of employment
The employment begins on 5 March 2023 and is concluded for an unlimited period.

2. Position
Cleaning and maintenance employee, part-time (35%).

3. Probation period
The first three months of employment are a probation period.

4. Salary
CHF 1,010 gross per month.

5. Working hours
According to the monthly rota, mainly early mornings from Monday to Friday.

(continued on page 2)

attachments.label: A3
attachments.text:
8. Notice period

8.1 After the probation period, the employment may be terminated by either party with a notice period of three months.

8.2 Notice may only be given to the end of a calendar month.

8.3 Notice must be given in writing and must reach the other party before the notice period begins.

8.4 By the last working day the employee shall hand over all keys, equipment and documents.
